MELD.probe_selection: seed67137 shuffled Train Dialogue IDs, one random Train utterance per dialogue; no target-value/label selection
MELD.intensity_threshold: none; unknown historical threshold is not invented

fit_scope: XP04 effective Train only; no Test feature or label slots indexed
validation_access: Only IDs/media metadata before model_lock; target values and candidate feature extraction deferred to one final evaluation
historical_validation_exposure: Prior audits inspected Validation feature summaries and a partial GRU check. This is not a never-seen new dataset; from this protocol onward no Validation feedback drives method or parameter selection. Generic row transforms are a fixed menu, not chosen from new Validation results.

cv.score_scale: fit-fold target column standard deviation floored at 1e-8
cv.tie_rule: Within 1 percent of best choose lowest prespecified complexity, then lexical configuration ID

linear_methods.normalization: fold Train X/Y zscore; target inverse transform from same fold
linear_methods.full_rank_ridge_solver: float64 train-fold moments, shared Gram/crossproduct; Cholesky per positive alpha, all targets jointly

stage_order: MELD frontend probe GroupCV / IEMOCAP full Train simple GroupCV
selected frontend full Train GroupCV for mapping
save fitted converter and lock hashes
one final Validation feature evaluation incl MELD full-context GRU
only if feature gate passes frozen CMERC probability parity
stop_complexity_rule: If simple model meets all feature tolerances on all OOF rows, retain simplest qualifying simple method; no needless larger model

classification.A: Original author converter provenance + parity; Train-derived exact relation is never A
classification.B: Reconstructed Train-fitted method, all fixed Validation feature and probability gates pass
classification.C: At least one gate fails, required coverage incomplete, or reconstruction unavailable

amendments.reason: Add explicitly requested full-rank regularized multi-output regression; rank256 negative results alone do not assess full linear mapping. Train-stage amendment, before any new Validation target/extraction.
amendments.changed: One full-rank Ridge alpha grid .01/1/100; prior frontend, thresholds, folds and validation boundaries unchanged
